title: Finite presentations over continuous field coefficients on a noetherian base
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], a finite normed extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with noetherian underlying topological space (every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes). Use the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention] and the coefficient ring $E_X^c=p_X^*C(-,E)$ of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. There is a canonical ring-sheaf isomorphism $E_X^c\cong (V\mapsto C(|V|,E))$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, where $V$ is a pro-etale site object and $|V|$ has its Zariski topology; the right side has pointwise operations and restrictions by composition. If an $E_X^c$-module sheaf $P$ has a pro-etale covering $\{V_\alpha\to X\}$ on which it is the cokernel of a map $(E_{V_\alpha}^c)^{m_\alpha}\to(E_{V_\alpha}^c)^{n_\alpha}$ with finite nonnegative $m_\alpha,n_\alpha$, then it has a pro-etale covering $\{W_\beta\to X\}$ on which $P|_{W_\beta}\cong(E_{W_\beta}^c)^{r_\beta}$ for finite nonnegative integers $r_\beta$. In particular this assertion applies to each noetherian locally closed stratum of a module sheaf constructible in the stratified local-finite-presentation sense of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], with strata as in [def-constructible-stratification]. No completeness condition on $P$ is assumed.

source.place: Example 3.1 (continuous-function realization of the coefficient ring); local-finite-presentation-to-local-freeness bridge required by the archived master ConstructibleSheaf/ProEtaleModule/Def.lean. Agent statement: the rank/descent argument is described in report.md; Theorem 6.2 describes the lisse heart but is not being quoted as proving this bridge.

proof.text: Use the uniquely characterized continuous coefficient realization. A finite normed extension of Q_l is totally disconnected by a finite-dimensional basis homeomorphism.
Choose the local finite presentations in hP and construct their continuous matrices. Define the corank functions n_i-rank. The common-fibre comparison makes them compatible over base points.

Continuous maps to the Hausdorff field E agree on comparable points, so each matrix and its corank are specialization invariant. Pro-etale cover maps are flat and jointly surjective. Apply the proved noetherian descent theorem to obtain a locally constant descended corank.

Pull back the descended corank to each cover member. The rank bound rank<=n and Nat.sub_sub_self recover local constancy of each matrix rank. Apply the local cokernel-freeness theorem and transport the given cokernel presentation isomorphisms.

Compose the resulting pro-etale covers with the original presentation cover. The monoidal inverse-image composition comparison and restriction-of-scalars equivalence transport finite freeness to the pullback along the composite.

For a locally closed stratum, transport coefficients along the canonical coefficient pullback isomorphism; finite-colimit-preserving additive functors carrying regular modules to regular modules preserve finite presentations. Apply the local-freeness theorem and transport the free-module witnesses back.
